Soul_TwoHandSpear.name: Soul Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Finish off a weakened enemy to fire souls forward, dealing damage from a distance.
This effect has a 10-second cooldown.

Legendary_Titan_Ring.name: Ring of Lightning
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Legendary_Titan_Ring} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5} to use it.
Deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.
Stand in the rain for 2 minutes to use it. When the rain stops, any stored energy will dissipate.

Fire_staff_spear_TwoHandSpear.name: Flame Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Deals fire damage to the target.
This effect can be charged up to 5 times, with each charge having a 5-second cooldown.

Anamorphic_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Constellation Helm
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} from the special equipment slot to select {StaticInfo:Item:Anamorphic_PlateArmor_Helm}, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
Reveals constellations that were previously hidden.

Bismuth_TwoHandSpear.name: Bismuth Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Deals bismuth damage to the target.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times, with each charge having a 5-second cooldown.

Gun_OneHandShield.name: Shotgun Shield
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the shield slot.
Block 3 enemy attacks to gain 1 charge. Press {Key:Key_Skill_2} to fire a burst of bullets.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times.

Hacking_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Circuit Hijacking Helm
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Hacking_PlateArmor_Helm} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
Hold {Key:Key_Guard} to aim, then release {Key:Key_Guard} when an enemy is detected to hijack its circuit.
It has a 10-sec cooldown.

Tarif_Necklace.name: Tarivian Necklace
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the necklace slot.
When critically wounded, the magic within the necklace grants you another chance at life, fully restoring your Health.
This effect has a 30-minute cooldown.

Fertilizer_Sprayer_BackPack.name: Fertilizer Sprayer
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the ranged weapon slot.
Hold {Key:Key_SubAttack} to ready and aim the sprayer.
Once aimed, press {Key:Key_HardAttack_DownOnce} to spray the fertilizer.
This effect can be charged up to 20 times, with each charge having a 30-second cooldown.

DarknessKing_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Plate Helm of the Shadows
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:DarknessKing_PlateArmor_Helm} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
It releases a cloud of frost that deals damage over time.
This effect has a 10-second cooldown.

Abyss_Surreal_Wolf_Leather_Helm.name: Jester Leather Mask
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the headgear slot.
Grants immunity to being dazed.

LakeGolem_OnehandShield.name: Runewalker Shield
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the shield slot.
Block 3 enemy attacks to gain 1 charge. Press {Key:Key_Skill_2} to unleash a pulse that deals damage.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times.

Marni_Laser_Helm.name: Marni Laser Helm
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select {StaticInfo:Item:Marni_Laser_Helm} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
Looking at an enemy will automatically mark them as a target and fire the laser.
This effect has a 1-minute cooldown.

Wind_Power_OneHandShield.name: Gale Shield
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the shield slot.
Block 3 enemy attacks to gain 1 charge. Press {Key:Key_Skill_2} to release a gust of wind.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times.

Witch_WingFan.name: Eastern Witch's Fan
parts: Press {Key:Key_HardAttack} to conjure a gust of wind that knocks back your enemies.
Press {Key:Key_Skill_1} to summon a whirlwind that sweeps enemies away.
Press {Key:Key_Skill_6_Start} to throw and retrieve the fan, dealing damage to enemies.
Press {Key:Key_Skill_7_Start} to pull nearby enemies together and strike them down with a powerful lightning.
Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Witch_WingFan} from the special equipment slot.
Press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to sweep away the clouds and clear up the sky.
This effect has a 10-minute cooldown.

Oil_Sprayer_BackPack.name: Lubricant Sprayer
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the ranged weapon slot.
Hold {Key:Key_SubAttack} to ready and aim the {StaticInfo:Item:Oil_Sprayer_BackPack}.
Press {Key:Key_HardAttack} to spray lubricant.

Scouter_HP_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Health Detection Device
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Scouter_HP_PlateArmor_Helm} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
When equipped, the target's {Staticinfo:Knowledge:Knowledge_Hp} will be visible to you.

AbyssReward_Drake_Metal_OneHandShield.name: Drake Shield
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the shield slot.
Block 3 enemy attacks to gain 1 charge. Press {Key:Key_Skill_2} to deal fire damage.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times.

Knowledge_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Helm of Knowledge
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the Helm of Knowledge from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it. Hold {Key:Key_Guard} and aim at a target to acquire knowledge from afar.
Using Blinding Flash or lighting the lantern while wearing the helm reveals nearby targets whose knowledge you have not yet acquired.

Lightning_TwoHandSpear.name: Lightning Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Deals lightning damage to the target.
This effect can be charged up to 5 times, with each charge having a 5-second cooldown.

Optionary_NonSlip_Gloves.name: Reins of Open Sky
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip them from the gloves slot.
It reduces the chance of slipping when pressing {Key:Key_ClimbIng} to hang onto walls.

Sound_OneHandShield.name: Shield of Ringing
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the shield slot.
Block 3 enemy attacks to gain 1 charge. Press {Key:Key_Skill_2} to release a sound wave that disorients enemies.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times.

IncreaseSwimmingSpeed_Plate_Boots.name: Tidebreaker Boots
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip them from the footwear slot.
Press {Key:Key_Evade} while swimming to burst forward a short distance.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times, with each charge having a 10-second cooldown.

Wind_TwoHandSpear.name: Propeller Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Shoots wind forward to knock back the target.
This effect can be charged up to 5 times, with each charge having a 5-second cooldown.

Folorin_Earring.name: Flower Petal Earring
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Folorin_Earring} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5} to use it.
The earing will play a melody, and using it again will stop the melody.

WaterSliding_Plate_Boots.name: Vaporwalker
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip them from the footwear slot.
Press {Key:Key_Slide} while running on land to slide into water and glide across the surface.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times, with each charge having a 10-second cooldown.

Heat_PlateArmor_Helm.name: Helm of Ignition
parts: Press {Key:HudSkillSlotPress} to select the {StaticInfo:Item:Heat_PlateArmor_Helm} from the special equipment slot, then press {Key:Key_Skill_5_Start} to use it.
It lights bonfires within a certain radius.

EMP_TwoHandSpear.name: Disruptor Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Shoots electro-magnetic pulses forward, causing mechanical malfunctions.
This effect can be charged up to 3 times, with each charge having a 10-second cooldown.

Marni_MachineKnight_TwoHandSpear.name: Electro-Mecha Spear
parts: Press {Key:HudQuickSlotPress} to equip it from the secondary weapon slot.
Deals lightning damage to the target.
This effect can be charged up to 5 times, with each charge having a 5-second cooldown.
